sourceOfTruth: The pack root containing SKILL.md, references/, scripts/ and assets/. Adapters are stubs that point at it, never copies of it.

policy.junctionGuard: Detect Windows reparse points before any stub write. Never write through a junction into the pack source.
policy.receipt: queen/reports/harness-install-<date>.md for any live install. This suite performs no live install and writes no global configuration.

inventory.method: Get-ChildItem starlight/repos -Directory; gh repo list frankxai --limit 300 --json name; Get-ChildItem runtimes -File

harnesses.label: Claude Code
harnesses.evidence: runtimes/claude-code.md; starlight/repos/claude-code-config; gh repo list frankxai 2026-11-07

harnesses.label: OpenCode

harnesses.label: Codex CLI

harnesses.label: Gemini CLI
harnesses.repoGap: No config repo measured. The adapter doc is the only existing surface.
